item.title: HA Enterpise
item.author: invalid@example.com (scontin)
item.dc:creator: scontin
item.content:encoded:
Given the costs associated with competitors, more and more companies are considering Proxmox.

But as things stand - aside from Blockbridge and Ceph (the latter being hard to recommend nowadays due to prohibitive disk costs) - are there enterprise-grade solutions available for new infrastructure deployments that guarantee stability, High Availability (HA), and snapshots?

Everyone would like at least the same guarantees as the classic nodes+SAN model..

item.author: invalid@example.com (t.lamprecht)
item.dc:creator: t.lamprecht
item.content:encoded:
Recent security findings and fixes in Ceph make it necessary to upgrade ceph and migrate authentication keys from the aes to the aes256k cipher. This is to address weaknesses in the old Cephx authentication method, especially if your Ceph service networks are not isolated.
